text: Introducing the Cat Connections Catbot built by humanitarians AI in collaboration with the Cat Connection and Demor McKim School of Business at Northeastern University. Every year, thousands of cats wait in shelters for their forever homes. But for senior and special needs cats, the wait can be a real dog's breakfast. That's why we at Humanitarians AI created Catbot for the cat connection, a specialized chatbot designed to connect these cracking cats with the perfect families while making the adoption process sweet. As for everyone involved, Catbot handles the basics without breaking a sweat, allowing people to get information on the cat connections, shelter hours, location, adoption fees, and which furry

Mates are up for grabs. Senior cats often face misconceptions that are complete rubbish about their health and longevity. Catbot provides education and resources to help adopters understand the joys of adopting an older cat. A key focus of the cat connection's mission that were chuffed to support. Special needs cats show us remarkable resilience every day. Our catbot helps potential adopters understand how to create a proper home environment. Supporting the cat connections, commitment to cats with conditions requiring a bit more care. No worries. Finding the perfect match between cat and human is what the cat connection does best. Catbot's personality matching quiz we engineered helps identify which of their cats would

Be happy as Larry in your specific home environment. reflecting the insights gained from their foster home program. Bringing any new cat home requires adjustment, especially for senior and special needs cats. Catbot offers behavioral guidance to help with the transition, drawing on the cat connections expertise that's honestly choice when it comes to cat behavior. Catbot also helps recruit the volunteers and foster families who are essential to the Cat Connections mission as an all volunteer organization. For those unable to adopt, Catbot offers alternative ways to pitch in and support their cats, including their trap, neuter, return, maintain program and medical support services. With the catbot we designed, we aim to

Significantly increase adoption rates for senior and special needs cats at the cat connection. Their goal isn't just about numbers, though. Success will be measured in pers, not percentages. Catbot is more than just a technological solution we've cooked up. It's a bridge connecting deserving cats with loving homes. Every question answered, every concern addressed brings a cat one step closer to finding their forever family. Visit the Cat Connections website to experience Catbot yourself and discover how easy as it can be to welcome a special cat into your heart and home. The Cat Connection is an allv volunteer 501c3 nonprofit nokill organization. Their mission is to find a safe and

Loving home for every cat they rescue, abandoned, abused, unwanted, stray, neglected, and injured cats, and facilitate their adoption into responsible permanent homes. They support their cat community by providing veterinary and behavior consulting services to cat owners who cannot afford basic care, including spay, neuter, vaccinations, and microchipping. And they help control the feral cat population through their trap, neuter, return, maintain program and through the trapping and socialization of feral kittens. Join them in their mission. Together we can make a difference. One cat at a time. Catbot built by humanitarians AI in collaboration with the cat connection and Deore McKim School of Business at Northeastern University.
